comment: The draft correctly identifies LOINC as one of the core internationally recognized terminologies a national Terminology Service (TS) must host and manage, alongside ICD-11 and SNOMED CT/GPS, and the glossary definition accurately reflects LOINC's full scope (measurements, observations, and documents — not laboratory results alone).

public.text: The draft correctly identifies LOINC as one of the core internationally recognized terminologies a national Terminology Service (TS) must host and manage, alongside ICD-11 and SNOMED CT/GPS, and the glossary definition accurately reflects LOINC's full scope (measurements, observations, and documents — not laboratory results alone).
public.suggestedRevision: No change requested. Noted as a strength worth preserving in future revisions.
